title: Kandy SC appoints 2026/27 Committee | Daily FT
summary:
Tuesday, 14 July 2026 04:18
-     - 0

By Shamseer Jaleel

Kandy SC Rugby Captain Tharindu Chathuranga

Mahesh Weerasinghe will continue to head Kandy Sports Club as the President of the Club for the 2026/2027 season. The Club’s Annual General Meeting was held at its Club House yesterday.

Kandy will have the major task of regaining the League and Knockout titles from CR, which they lost last year. They will once again be led by former Kingswoodian and National XV vice-captain Tharindu Chathuranga.

Cargills will continue with the Club as the Platinum sponsor, while TVS Lanka will be the Associate sponsor, with Euro Motors coming in as the new sponsor.

Committee – 2026/2027

Patron: Ranjit Page

Trustees: Mahesh Weerasinghe, Sarath Perera, Anton Nanayakkara

President: Mahesh Weerasinghe

Vice Presidents: Lasantha Wijesuriya, Janaka Pathirana, Ashan Ratwatte

Secretary: Sujeewa Liyanage

Treasurer: Upali Silva

Ground Secretary: Janaka Pathirana

Bar and Social Secretary: Anuruddha Ranasinghe

Pavilion Secretary: Abdul Rasheed

Legal Consultant: Mohamed Jiffry

Committee Members: Arfath Abdeen, Dr. Anura Walikala, Kapila Silva, Gayan Dodanwala, Nigel Ratwatte, Gamika De Silva and Fazil Marija

Rugby Chairman: Nigel Ratwatte
